script: This is your final checklist, and it covers ninety days. Each stage has one main goal. Tick it off in your notebook as you go. In week one, choose your skill and set up your free tools. Your Gmail, WhatsApp Business, Canva and Drive should all be ready. In week two, complete the foundations and the first lessons of your skill. In weeks three and four, make your first two samples, and save them in your portfolio folder. In weeks five and six, make four more samples and build your portfolio page. You should have six samples and a portfolio link ready to share. In week seven, set up your profiles and your tracking sheet. Your profile should be complete, and your sheet should be live.
glossary: Canva, WhatsApp Business, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, CapCut, Payoneer, OTP, PIN, freelance, Facebook, Instagram
